faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our academy.

items.question: At what age can I enroll my child?
items.answer: We accept children from 4 years old. We have specific programs adapted to each age group, ensuring the experience is suitable for each child's development.

items.question: Is previous football experience necessary?
items.answer: No! We welcome children of all levels, from complete beginners to youth with some experience. Our coaches adapt exercises to each student's level.

items.question: What do I need to bring to training?
items.answer: We recommend comfortable sports clothing, suitable soccer cleats or sneakers, shin guards and a water bottle. Academy equipment can be optionally purchased.

items.question: Can I do an experimental class before enrolling?
items.answer: Of course! We offer a free experimental class so that child and parents can get to know our facilities, coaches and working methodology.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: We offer monthly payment by direct debit or bank transfer. We also have quarterly and annual payment options with a discount. Sports insurance is included in the monthly fee.

items.question: Are trainings cancelled when it rains?
items.answer: We have an indoor field for bad weather days, ensuring training continuity throughout the year. In cases of extreme weather conditions, parents will be notified in advance.
